summary: Iteration-2 testing (WhatsApp reminders, subscription receipts, analytics dashboard, AI invoice draft). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter2_features.py with 4 pytest cases covering all four new backend endpoints/features — 4/4 pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: registered fresh business owner (auto Pro trial), seeded customer/product/finalized-unpaid invoice, then verified: (a) /reminders page renders reminders-title + reminder-row-<INV> and the whatsapp-btn opens https://wa.me/919876543210?text=... with prefilled invoice number & amount; (b) /subscription renders subscription-title without JS errors, receipts-section is correctly absent for a user who never paid; (c) /analytics renders 6 recharts containers + 6 KPI-like cards for a Pro-trial user; (d) Ask Vyastha FAB -> ai-input -> ai-send-btn -> ai-action-card -> ai-action-confirm navigates to /invoices/new with buyer='Ramesh Traders', line item 'chair', qty 5, unit price 500 PREFILLED. All flows passed cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2369 lines — approaching monolith size; consider splitting reminders/receipts/analytics into separate routers under /app/backend/routers/ for maintainability.

GET /api/subscription/receipts recomputes receipt_number from index each request — indexes shift if a paid transaction is later inserted/deleted, causing the same receipt to change number across calls. Persist receipt_number on the payment_transactions row at payment-success time.

extract_invoice_draft catches all Exceptions but on failure ask() still returns generic navigate action while claiming intent — consider surfacing a user-visible 'draft nahi bana paaya' fallback so UX is not confusing when LLM JSON parse fails.

RemindersPage WhatsApp button uses window.open(url) inside onClick. Add rel='noopener' equivalent and/or fall back to an <a href={whatsapp_url} target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'> so the middle-click / right-click / copy-link UX and popup blockers behave correctly (also makes it easier to test).
test_credentials: Fresh TEST_iter2_<hex>@qatest-vyastha.com registered per pytest run (auto 90-day Pro trial). Admin: admin@vyastha.com / adminpassword123 (unused this iteration).
seed_data_creation: Per-run: customer 'Ramesh Traders' (phone 9876543210), product 'chair' @₹500, one finalized-unpaid invoice with 5x chair. All tenant-scoped to disposable TEST_ users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter2 backend suite = /app/backend/tests/test_iter2_features.py (4 tests, all pass). Reuse the seed_js block from playwright script if you need customer/product/invoice quickly. WA button behaviour: use window.__openedUrl override to capture the wa.me URL instead of trying to intercept popups. AI invoice_draft response can take up to ~30s — allow 60s timeout on ai-action-card. Prefill happens via sessionStorage 'vyastha_invoice_draft' consumed in InvoiceBuilderPage useEffect.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found; only code-quality suggestions listed above.
